note: Pinned vectors reproduce the published fixed-rate, variable-rate and non-delivery illustrations in the primary text retrieved 2026-11-20. Cent-level rounding drift in some printed outstanding-cost cells is disclosed as a named selling-price residual; the node emits the internally consistent annuity recurrence (half-even on each period profit). Late-payment amounts are pass-through only. All inputs are synthetic amounts and rates; no personal data.
